blocks.text: [ Principle 09 ]
Principle 9: My Hometown
(Where I Was Born)
I was born in 1970 in a small town, beautiful mountains surrounded it.
Some years were hard and the winters were cold with heavy snow.
It was a long walk to get to school.
I often had to run all the way to school and back to home.
Sometimes I'm strong enough that I used to climbs hills.
I never get afraid of running or walking along way even these days.
I used to climb hills and trees with friends day and night
(Move to the City)
My father started working in the big city so my family moved there.
Because of my father‘s job my family had to move several times.
City life is very convenient but sometimes I miss the country life.
We lived in a high-rise apartment building and it was not that big.
Even though the apartment was small there was a beautiful park near by.
(Where I Grew Up)
When I was in the 5th grade in Elementary school I moved to the city.
I spent the rest of my school days in the big city.
Most of my friends I made in the city.
Although I was not born here it is my second hometown.
